question: Read-path correctable-error activity can separate missed-fault rows from healthy rows: do explicit presence/missing indicators for read_ce fields, recent read_ce_count magnitudes, and interactions between read_ce_count and aggregate CE counts distinguish FN from TN and high-score TP from FP?
reason: Error atlas already shows credible FN-vs-TN separation for read_ce_log_num_1h/15m and read_ce_count_1h/15m (AUC 0.855/0.815/0.844/0.814), while high-score contrast only had limited credible features. The base model uses raw counts but may not exploit the large missingness contrast (22% missing in FN vs 84% in TN) or read-CE interaction. Ask for causally available read-CE presence/missing indicators and count interactions rather than another parameter change.
expected: Added read-CE features provide at least one credible exploratory AUC in FN/TN contrast and improve CV OOF recall or precision enough to increase F1 over trial_001.
falsification: If the new read-CE features do not produce credible FN/TN or TP/FP separation and do not change CV TP/FP/FN relative to trial_001, H6 is not supported in this representation.
